'''Vorrnti City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the planet [[Vorrnti]]. It contained a [[Blackie's|junkyard]]. The entrepreneur [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] visited shortly before [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] and acquired a derelict [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] with the help of the [[Katarn Commandos]] from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
